items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Yeah I worked for Clyde Beatty in there.

ctx.x: And you know, pretty much Jack Kerr and then the boys made me quit Jack and we made up a band and put money in. That's how I got to get up there. God Beans was crazy about me you know.
What about Clyde Beatty? You told me you worked for him once. Oh yeah, the animal man. Yeah I worked for Clyde Beatty in there.

Big stone there and blowed everything down. Blowed the top down on us man. I used to get the parking lot and cut my way through. Where was that? Up in uh somewhere in Wisconsin. Yeah I worked for two summers I mean. Two summers. What kind of stuff you played? Oh we had a college show on there. Oh? A college show. But we tried to play, when we get to town you know, play parades you know. Played parades. We didn't get off and play that night and play something. I thought maybe you played Tiger Rag a lot.
